web.title: Complete guide to egg codes: what they reveal about hens
web.description:
# Complete guide to egg codes: what they reveal about hens
Each egg has an alphanumeric code that starts with the digits 0, 1, 2, or 3.

Code 0 – Organic eggs

Code 1 – Free-range eggs

Free-range hens, which produce eggs labeled with code 1, also have access to the outdoors, but their conditions are not as strict as those for organic hens.

Code 2 – Barn eggs (formerly called “floor-raised”)

Hens producing eggs with code 2 are not caged but live inside barns where they can move freely.
